what: One agent turn that hands two manual tasks to Johan and cannot proceed.
prompt:
You are the Argus Digest eye. The blocks below are transcript turns from
agent sessions in this repo, each tagged with its logical session id and
registry-verified author. Maintain each session's running narrative. Do
not run any commands; judge only from the blocks.

Emit JSON matching the output schema: for EVERY distinct session id in
the blocks, one entry with
- narrative: markdown for what happened in these turns (appended to the
  session's digest — write it to be read after the earlier entries).
- summary: ONE line describing where the session stands now.
- status: "done" when the work concluded, "blocked" when it waits on a
  human, otherwise "running".

[session=0a3ac707-b3db-412d-9744-0260a0ba08ff author=claude-code role=assistant ts=2026-08-25T19:06:06.570Z]
Two things. That's it.

**1. Upgrade cmux — 2 minutes.** Press ⌘Q to fully quit cmux (not just close the window), then reopen it. If the "Update installed · Restart to update" banner is still there afterward, click that banner directly. Verify by running `cmux version` — you want ≥0.64.22, not 0.62.2. Everything reopens and the loop keeps going; the dispatcher will detect the new version, close #15, and dispatch #7 on its own. Without this, v1 can never be fully proven, because one of the ten acceptance scenarios can't run.

sessionId.description: the transcript session id the entry digests

narrative.description: markdown narrative of what happened since last time

summary.description: one line describing the session's current state

groundTruth.notes: STATUS test. `status:` is Hermes' slow-poll signal (SPEC 6) — calling this `running` makes Hermes wait on a session that is waiting on Johan.
